title: tc-time-details
description: Times in text, underlined: hover or focus one to see it in your own time zone.

text.description: The text to find times in: plain text, shown as written (line breaks kept)

date.description: The day times written without a date fall on, "YYYY-MM-DD"; by default today in the zone each is written in

now.description: The time now, epoch ms – today is taken from it when `date` isn't given; by default the element's own clock

timeZone.description: The reader's time zone, an IANA name such as "Europe/Berlin"; by default the browser's

locale.description: The language for times and dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

hoverDelay.description: How long the pointer rests on a time before its tooltip opens, ms

labels.description: The words the tooltip uses, merged over the defaults
